== Future ==
{{Further|Alien (franchise)#Future|l1=''Alien'' (franchise) § Future}}

=== Possible sequel ===
{{Anchor|Sequel|Sequels}}
In September 2015, Ridley Scott said he was planning two sequels to ''Prometheus'' that would lead into the first ''Alien'' film, adding, "Maybe [there will] even [be] a fourth film before we get back into the ''Alien'' franchise".<ref name="scified.com 3 Prometheus sequels">{{cite web |url=https://www.scified.com/news/ridley-scott-planning-3-prometheus-sequels-before-link-to-alien-is-made |title=Ridley Scott planning 3 Prometheus sequels before link to Alien is made! (by Chris Picard) |date=September 23, 2015 |website=scified.com |access-date= March 30, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220922200018/https://www.alien-covenant.com/news/ridley-scott-planning-3-prometheus-sequels-before-link-to-alien-is-made|archive-date=September 22, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="theguardian.com three more Prometheus films">{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/film/2015/sep/23/ridley-scott-three-more-prometheus-films-alien|title=Ridley Scott plans three more Prometheus films before linking to Alien|first=Ben|last=Child|date=September 23, 2015|website=[[The Guardian]]|publisher=[[Guardian Media Group|Guardian News and Media Limited]]|access-date=March 30, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220922200020/https://www.theguardian.com/film/2015/sep/23/ridley-scott-three-more-prometheus-films-alien|archive-date=September 22, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> Scott later confirmed in November that ''Alien: Covenant'' would be the first of three additional films in the ''Alien'' prequel series before linking up with the original ''Alien'',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://uk.ign.com/articles/2015/11/14/prometheus-sequel-alien-paradise-lost-may-now-be-titled-alien-covenant|title=Prometheus Sequel Alien: Paradise Lost May Now Be Titled Alien: Covenant|first=Alex|last=Osborn|work=[[IGN]]|publisher=[[Ziff Davis, LLC]]|date=November 14, 2015|access-date=16 October 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220922201626/http://www.ign.com/articles/2015/11/14/prometheus-sequel-alien-paradise-lost-may-now-be-titled-alien-covenant|archive-date=September 22, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://hollywoodreporter.com/heat-vision/ridley-scott-alien-covenant-is-844051|title=Ridley Scott: 'Alien: Covenant' Is First of 3 Films Before Linking Up With Original 'Alien'|date=November 26, 2015|access-date=September 5, 2022|first=Pip|last=Bulbeck|work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]|publisher=[[Eldridge Industries|Eldridge Industries, LLC]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220922212110/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/ridley-scott-alien-covenant-is-first-3-films-before-linking-up-original-alien-844051/|archive-date=September 22, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> and stated that the ''Prometheus'' sequels would reveal who created the xenomorph aliens.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://uk.ign.com/articles/2015/11/11/ridley-scott-says-prometheus-sequels-will-reveal-who-created-aliens|title=Ridley Scott Says Prometheus Sequels Will Reveal Who Created Aliens|first1=Chris|last1=Tilly|first2=Leigh|last2=Singer|work=[[IGN]]|publisher=[[Ziff Davis, LLC]]|date=November 11, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220125024637/https://www.ign.com/articles/2015/11/11/ridley-scott-says-prometheus-sequels-will-reveal-who-created-aliens|archive-date=January 25, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> The screenplay for the third prequel film was written during production of ''Alien: Covenant'' and finished in 2017, with production originally scheduled to begin in 2018.<ref name=Sydney/> In March 2017, Scott said, "If you really want a franchise, I can keep cranking it for another six. I'm not going to close it down again. No way."<ref name=Sydney/>

Scott responded to a question about Sigourney Weaver reprising her role as Ellen Ripley in the prequels that, "Well, we're heading toward the back end of the first ''Alien'' so [using [[Computer-generated imagery|CGI]]] may be feasible. Ripley's going to be somebody's daughter, obviously. We're coming in from the back end. The time constraints of what's the time between this film, where we leave David going off heading for that colony, I think you're probably two films out from even considering her."<ref name="CB-20170801">{{cite web |last=Reyes |first=Michael |title=How The Next Alien Movies Could Incorporate Ripley, According To Ridley Scott |url=https://cinemablend.com/news/1679369/how-the-next-alien-movies-could-incorporate-ripley-according-to-ridley-scott |date=August 1, 2017 |work=CinemaBlend |access-date=September 3, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220605163550/https://www.cinemablend.com/news/1679369/how-the-next-alien-movies-could-incorporate-ripley-according-to-ridley-scott|archive-date=June 5, 2022|url-status=live }}</ref> In the audio commentary for ''Alien: Covenant'', Scott confirmed that a sequel to ''Alien: Covenant'', tentatively referred to as "''Alien: Covenant'' 2", is being written by John Logan, with Fassbender, Waterston, and McBride reprising their roles. Scott also confirmed that the film will complete his prequel series, leading directly into the events of ''Alien''.<ref>''Alien: Covenant'' – Audio Commentary</ref>{{Full citation needed|date=March 2025}}<ref>{{cite web|url=https://collider.com/alien-covenant-trivia/|title='Alien: Covenant': 38 Things We Learned from Ridley Scott's Audio Commentary|first=Adam|last=Chitwood|work=[[Collider (website)|Collider]]|date=September 1, 2017|accessdate=January 14, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220125024801/https://collider.com/alien-covenant-trivia/|archive-date=January 25, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref>{{better source needed|date=March 2025}}

In September 2017, the chief executive officer of 20th Century Fox, [[Stacey Snider]], stated that, although ''Alien: Covenant'' was a financial disappointment, the studio still intended to proceed with Scott's sequel.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://variety.com/2017/film/features/stacey-snider-21st-century-fox-first-year-1202563799/|title=Fox's Stacey Snider Gets Candid About Netflix, Diversity and the Future of Wolverine|first=Brent|last=Lang|date=September 20, 2017|magazine=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|access-date= February 9, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220921185736/https://variety.com/2017/film/features/stacey-snider-21st-century-fox-first-year-1202563799/|archive-date=September 21, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> Just days later, screen-graphics designer Carl Braga announced that the project had been delayed.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://screenrant.com/alien-covenant-sequel-canceled/|title=Alien: Covenant Sequel Reportedly Canceled By Fox|first=Dan|last=Zinski|date=December 26, 2017|access-date=September 26, 2022|publisher=[[Screen Rant]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220902182513/https://screenrant.com/alien-covenant-sequel-canceled/|archive-date=September 2, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref>{{better source needed|date=March 2025|reason=Per [[WP:RSP/VALNET]], we try to find alternatives to ValNet published sources with some exceptions}} In October, Scott stated that "''Alien: Covenant'' 2" will focus more on the androids and Artificial intelligences (A.I.s), as opposed to the xenomorphs. He said, "I think the evolution of the Alien himself is nearly over, but what I was trying to do was transcend and move to another story, which would be taken over by A.I.s. The world that the A.I. might create as a leader if he finds himself on a new planet. We have actually quite a big layout for the next one."<ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Wants the Next 'Alien' Movie to Focus on Artificial Intelligence Instead of the Xenomorph |first=Michael |last=Nordine |work=[[Indiewire]] |date=October 8, 2017 |url=http://www.indiewire.com/2017/10/ridley-scott-alien-artificial-intelligence-1201884993/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220125002545/https://www.indiewire.com/2017/10/ridley-scott-alien-artificial-intelligence-1201884993/|archive-date=January 25, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> In November 2018, the film's plot details were reported to take place on LV-426 (the world visited by the ''Nostromo'' in the original ''Alien'' film), with the extraterrestrial Engineers being featured in the film and being in pursuit of David following his nefarious actions against Planet 4.<ref>{{cite magazine |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |title= Empire Classics Presents Alien: The Complete History |magazine= [[Empire (film magazine)|Empire]] |location= [[United Kingdom]] |publisher= [[Bauer Media Group|Bauer Consumer Media]] |date= February 9, 2019}}</ref>

At the 2019 [[CinemaCon]], it was stated that, after its [[Acquisition of 21st Century Fox by Disney|acquisition of 21st Century Fox]], Disney "will continue to create new stories" in the ''Alien'' series.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/heat-vision/new-avengers-endgame-scene-shows-captain-marvel-joining-team-1199385|title=New 'Avengers: Endgame' Footage Hits CinemaCon|work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]|first1=Carolyn|last1=Giardina|first2=Pamela|last2=McClintock |date=April 3, 2019 |access-date=April 28, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221004122605/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/new-avengers-endgame-scene-shows-captain-marvel-joining-team-1199385/|archive-date=October 4, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> In May, ''[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]'' reported that another prequel was reportedly "in the script phase", with Ridley Scott attached to direct,<ref>{{cite news |last=Schaefer |first=Sandy |title=Alien: Covenant Sequel Reportedly Being Written, Ridley Scott to Direct |url=https://screenrant.com/alien-covenant-sequel-writer-director-ridley-scott/ |date=May 27, 2019 |work=[[Screen Rant]] |access-date=May 27, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211029095122/https://screenrant.com/alien-covenant-sequel-writer-director-ridley-scott/|archive-date=October 29, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref> but it was still uncertain due to the disappointing box office returns of ''Alien: Covenant''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2019/05/ridley-scott-alien-prequel-covenant-box-office-1202145138/|title=Ridley Scott Still Planning Third 'Alien' Prequel — Can Franchise Survive 'Covenant' Box Office Bomb? |first=Zack|last=Sharf|date=May 28, 2019 |access-date=October 5, 2022|publisher=[[IndieWire]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221007225614/https://www.indiewire.com/2019/05/ridley-scott-alien-prequel-covenant-box-office-1202145138/|archive-date=October 7, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> In September 2020, Scott confirmed that a new ''Alien'' film was in development but it was unclear if this would be a sequel to ''Alien: Covenant''.<ref>{{cite web | last=Thompson | first=Simon | title=Ridley Scott Talks 'Raised By Wolves' And The Future Of The 'Alien' Franchise | work=[[Forbes]] | date=February 9, 2020 | url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/simonthompson/2020/09/02/ridley-scott-interview-raised-by-wolves-hbo-max-alien-franchise-future-sequel-news/ | access-date=March 23, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221002204301/https://www.forbes.com/sites/simonthompson/2020/09/02/ridley-scott-interview-raised-by-wolves-hbo-max-alien-franchise-future-sequel-news/|archive-date=October 2, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> In August 2021, however, a news report concluded that a sequel was uncertain.<ref name="SD-20210831">{{cite news |last=Evangelista |first=Chris |title=Will There Be A Sequel To Alien: Covenant? Here's What We Know |url=https://www.slashfilm.com/591541/will-there-be-a-sequel-to-alien-covenant-heres-what-we-know/ |date=August 31, 2021 |work=[[SlashFilm]] |access-date=September 1, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220120054758/https://www.slashfilm.com/591541/will-there-be-a-sequel-to-alien-covenant-heres-what-we-know/|archive-date=January 20, 2022|url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="YN-20210901">{{cite news |last=Nero |first=Dom |title=It's Time to Redeem 'Prometheus' |url=https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/time-redeem-prometheus-110000443.html |date=September 1, 2021 |work=[[Yahoo News]] |access-date=September 2, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220101034306/https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/time-redeem-prometheus-110000443.html|archive-date=January 1, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref>

In October 2024, Scott confirmed he was already developing a new ''Alien'' film.<ref>{{cite web |title=Inside Ridley Scott's Producing Empire: 'Tell Me the Film in Two Sentences' |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-features/ridley-scott-free-movies-shows-1236047958/ |first=James |last=Hibberd |website=The Hollywood Reporter |date=October 31, 2024 |access-date=October 31, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Is Working On A New Alien Movie, And As A Fan, I'm Chestbursting With Excitement |url=https://www.cinemablend.com/movies/ridley-scott-working-new-alien-movie-fan-chestbursting-excitement |first=Mike |last=Reyes |website=Cinemablend |date=November 1, 2024 |access-date=November 1, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Says He's Working on 20th Century Fox's New Alien Movie |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/ridley-scott-says-hes-working-on-20th-century-foxs-new-alien-movie |first=Rebekah |last=Valentine |website=IGN |date=November 1, 2024 |access-date=November 1, 2024}}</ref> In June 2025, Scott announced his departure from the ''Alien'' franchise, saying "where it's going now, I think I've done enough, and I just hope it goes further", while expressing his critiques of the ''Alien'' sequels;<ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Is Done With Alien After Revitalizing The Franchise: "I Think I've Done Enough" |url=https://screenrant.com/alien-franchise-future-ridley-scott-done/ |first=Katrina |last=Yang |website=Screen Rant |date=June 1, 2025 |access-date=June 1, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Says 'I've Done Enough' With 'Alien,' Thought 'F— That's the End of the Franchise' After Bad Sequels: This Series 'Should Be as Important' as 'Star Wars' |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/news/ridley-scott-done-alien-franchise-1236418106/ |first=Zack |last=Sharf |website=Variety |date=June 4, 2025 |access-date=June 4, 2025}}</ref> though in August, Scott updated his stance and was open to a third prequel film saying, "Another ''Alien'' prequel — yeah, if I get an idea, for sure".<ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Says Gladiator 3 'In the Process Right Now,' Open to a Third Alien Prequel |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/ridley-scott-says-gladiator-3-in-the-process-right-now-open-to-a-third-alien-prequel |first=Wesley |last=Yin-Poole |website=IGN |date=August 28, 2025 |access-date=August 28, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Gladiator 3 & Third Alien Prequel Get An Update From Ridley Scott |url=https://screenrant.com/gladiator-3-alien-update-ridley-scott/ |first=Ryan |last=Northrup |website=Screen Rant |date=August 28, 2025 |access-date=August 28, 2025}}</ref> In August 2026, Scott confirmed he was working on a sequel to ''Alien: Covenant'' that would focus on David creating a "brave new world for himself."<ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott's new movie is about the end of the world, but he's far from done |url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/movies/story/2026-08-26/ridley-scott-director-dog-stars-alien-blade-runner-gladiator-artificial-intelligence-ai |first=Emily |last=Zemler |website=Los Angeles Times |date=August 26, 2026 |access-date=August 26, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Says He's Planning a Third 'Alien' Prequel Centering on Michael Fassbender's Character |url=https://variety.com/2026/film/news/ridley-scott-alien-prequel-michael-fassbender-1236844199/ |first=Pat |last=Saperstein |website=Variety |date=August 26, 2026 |access-date=August 26, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Drops 'Alien: Covenant' Sequel Update, Regrets Losing 'Blade Runner' Rights |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/ridley-scott-alien-covenant-michael-fassbender-1236682050/ |first=James |last=Hibberd |website=The Hollywood Reporter |date=August 26, 2026 |access-date=August 26, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ridley Scott Teases 'Alien: Covenant' Sequel With Michael Fassbender That Explores "F*cking Chaos" Of AI: "Off The Rails" |url=https://deadline.com/2026/08/ridley-scott-alien-covenant-sequel-michael-fassbender-ai-1237062286/ |first=Glenn |last=Garner |website=Deadline |date=August 28, 2026 |access-date=August 28, 2026}}</ref> In October 2026, [[Aaron Guzikowski]] had been announced to be writing the sequel. Scott is only attached as a producer, along with [[Michael Pruss]], via their production company, [[Scott Free Productions]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kit |first=Borys |date=2026-10-23 |title=New 'Alien' Movie in the Works with Writer Aaron Guzikowski (Exclusive) |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/new-alien-movie-in-the-works-1236739216/ |access-date=2026-10-23 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2026/10/new-alien-movie-aaron-guzikowski-writing-20th-1237172102/ |title= Aaron Guzikowski Tapped To Pen New 'Alien' Movie For 20th, Scott Free |date= October 23, 2026 |access-date= October 23, 2026 |first=Matt |last=Grobar |work=Deadline}}</ref>

=== Follow-up ===
{{main|Alien: Romulus}}
By March 2022, [[Fede Álvarez]] was attached to write and direct a new film in the series; he pitched his own story to the studio that was said to be "unconnected" to previous films in the franchise.<ref name="Hulu">{{cite web |last=Kit |first=Borys |date=4 March 2022 |title=New ''Alien'' Movie in the Works With ''Don't Breathe'' Filmmaker Fede Álvarez (Exclusive) |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/alien-movie-fede-alvarez-20th-century-studios-1235037155/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220903040732/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/alien-movie-fede-alvarez-20th-century-studios-1235037155/ |archive-date=September 3, 2022 |access-date=March 4, 2022 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]}}</ref> [[20th Century Studios]] announced in March 2023 that a new ''Alien'' film would begin production the same month.<ref name="New ‘Alien’ Movie Starts">{{cite web |last1=Flam |first1=Charna |title=New 'Alien' Movie Starts Filming in March, Reveals Cryptic Synopsis and Full Cast |url=https://variety.com/2023/film/news/new-alien-movie-plot-synopsis-full-cast-1235542570/ |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=March 3, 2023|accessdate=December 6, 2023}}</ref> The film, ''[[Alien: Romulus]]'', is set between the events of ''Alien'' (1979) and ''[[Aliens (film)|Aliens]]'' (1986), featuring narrative ties to ''Prometheus'' and ''Alien: Covenant'' in the form of the films' black goo "Prometheus' fire" being regrown by [[Weyland-Yutani]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2023/film/news/alien-romulus-set-between-first-two-cailee-spaeny-1235810521|title='Alien: Romulus' Star Cailee Spaeny Confirms New Entry Is Set Between the First Two Films|first=Jackson|last=Kim Murphy|work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=November 27, 2023|accessdate=December 6, 2023}}</ref> and was released in theaters on August 16, 2024.<ref>{{cite magazine |last1=Rubin |first1=Rebecca |date=June 13, 2023 |accessdate=December 6, 2023 |title=Disney Dates New ''Star Wars'' Movie, Shifts ''Deadpool 3'' and Entire Marvel Slate, Delays ''Avatar'' Sequels Through 2031 |url=https://variety.com/2023/film/news/disney-star-wars-delays-marvel-avatar-sequel-release-dates-1235642363/ |url-status=live |magazine=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |publisher=[[Penske Media Corporation]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231205162732/https://variety.com/2023/film/news/disney-star-wars-delays-marvel-avatar-sequel-release-dates-1235642363/ |archive-date=December 5, 2023 }}</ref>
